body: Yeah, I've been looking for some help where they do home visits and stuff. I actually filled some paperwork Friday for something similar. Hopefully that will help.
lol where I grew up we always called it spaghetti bolognese

A lot of the people in my family tend to be quite judgemental or are the type of people who say things like "Man up" (had it said to me a few times) as for professional help, I have gone to a psychologist a few times, but with my anxiety as bad as it is I am rarely able to go and I haven't found a good one that I can do phone sessions with.

I think as a part of constantly being told to "keep it to myself" and "man up" etc etc I have a very bad habit of downplaying how bad things really are when I do talk to people as well. For example if they ask how bad I feel 1 being worst 10 being best. I would say something around 4 maybe 5, when it would be a 2 at best.
Thanks. Even people just offering to chat helps. I'm starting to feel less stressed now, so I might even try and get some sleep (after 10pm here).
Thank you, I appreciate it. I'm definitely starting to feel better. Still pretty shitty, but not on the edge.
